tweet_text: each experiment runs 3 sessions on the same world: communicate (agents draw glyphs), silent (same agents, no communication channel), and random (pure chance). comparing score curves shows the value of communication. communicate consistently outperforms both - tho not because agents agree on symbol meanings. the act of drawing and interpreting seems to make agents more deliberate about their actions, even when the interpretation is wrong.
